h: At least 64 Katsina students reportedly hospitalised after reacting to bilharzia treatment drugs
p: At least 64 students in Katsina State have reportedly been taken to hospital after reacting to drugs given as bilharzia treatment. Health officials are said to be monitoring their condition.
more: The students were reportedly given the drugs as part of a treatment exercise.
State health authorities had not said how many were discharged at the time of reporting.
